<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Special Parliament Session:</strong> A special session beginning November 30 will address the women’s quota and potential delimitation, intensifying political friction as the opposition challenges the government&#x27;s pursuit of a two-thirds majority.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I9</a></span></li>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Supreme Court Rulings:</strong> The Supreme Court has taken a firm stance on accountability, criticizing multinational corporations for inconsistent food quality standards and mandating that banks expedite the prosecution of officials within seven days.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W5</a></span></li>
